headline: OpenAI's head of ethics departs amid leadership changes
body: OpenAI's head of ethics Chloé Bakalar has left the organization, marking a significant departure from the AI safety function at one of healthcare's most influential foundation model providers. This exit occurs as OpenAI simultaneously closes a $7B funding round, raising questions about the company's governance and ethical oversight priorities during rapid scaling. For healthcare AI implementations, this signals potential shifts in how OpenAI approaches safety guardrails and compliance considerations that hospitals and health systems rely on when deploying GPT models in clinical workflows. Healthcare vendors integrating OpenAI's APIs should monitor governance changes and audit their vendor risk assessments, particularly for sensitive applications involving patient data and clinical decision support.
